sentences.en: The successful concert tour established her reputation as a singer.
sentences.zh: 这次成功的巡演确立了她歌手的身份。

sentences.en: He likes to boast about his father's successful automobile business.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢吹嘘他父亲那成功的汽车生意。

sentences.en: Every successful writer has a drawer full of rejection letters.
sentences.zh: 每个成功作家的抽屉里都堆满了拒稿信。

senses.zh: 成功的，如愿以偿的；事业有成的，飞黄腾达的；（公司、影片、产品等）利润丰厚的，非常赚钱的
